verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Ollama letting users override low-level engine settings such as mlock or mmap. The only on-topic item is a community report that Ollama hides llama.cpp server configs behind its own 'sane defaults' and won't allow mlock. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
